title: Browse performers
description: Use performer pages to explore appearances, relationships, ratings, and related people.

blocks.text: A performer page collects the media and groups associated with one person. Summary counts show which content exists before you switch tabs. Ratings, descriptive fields, tags, and the biography help distinguish people with similar names.

blocks.alt: Performer detail page with content tabs, Appears With, and Similar controls identified

sections.title: Move from one performer to another

items: Content tabs divide appearances by media type and show a count for each.
Appears With ranks the people this performer shares videos with by how many videos they have together.
Similar suggests other performers based on Cove's available similarity data.
Edit updates identity, descriptive metadata, images, tags, and other fields when your role permits it.

sections.title: See who a performer works with

items: Co-stars are listed in one ranked list, a page at a time. Frequent partners share five or more videos with the performer, recurring co-stars two to four, and one-time co-stars one; the Frequent, Recurring and One-time filters show just one of these, with a count on each.

Each co-star shows the years and studios of their videos together and the latest of them. The play button queues those videos, and the arrow opens them in the Videos tab, or opens the video itself when there is only one.

Filters offers the same video filters as the Videos tab. Only the shared videos they match count, so filtering by a tag shows who the performer appears with in videos with that tag, ranked by those videos, and the links to those videos keep the filter.

Duos only counts just the videos with the two of them. The gender and Favorites filters narrow the list, and Sort orders it by videos together, the most recent or first video together, the longest partnership, or name.
Tick co-stars to build a lineup. It counts the videos with all of them and with any of them, and opens either list.
